name: Oldsmobile V8 (400 / 455)
description: The Oldsmobile big-block V8: the 1965-67 and 1968-69 400s and the 455, with their factory builds (the L69 Tri-Carb, the 4-4-2, the W-30 with Force-Air, the Hurst/Olds) and a 455 crate engine. Every part ours, drawn from solids; the Turbo Hydra-Matic from Jorma Rysky's "Naturally Aspirated 454 cid V8" (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

builds.engine: Oldsmobile 455 W-30 crate engine with headers

credits: "Naturally Aspirated 454 cid V8" by Jorma Rysky (sketchfab.com/Rysky), CC BY 4.0 (the Turbo Hydra-Matic)
